public.text: “Integrate before you replace” is stated as an almost universal preference where data is difficult to recreate. Integration can extend the life of unsafe, unsupported, or prohibitively expensive systems.
public.suggestedRevision: Qualify the principle: preserve and migrate valuable data, but integrate the legacy application only where the risk, cost, remaining life, security, and supportability justify doing so.
